summary: Describes using MPLS multi-segment pseudowires where a passive optical network meets an MPLS network. This suits mobile backhaul, where many end nodes sit close to aggregation devices. It looks at how the segments can be handled without making those many nodes too complicated. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Many small cell towers need to connect through shared fibre to the big network. This explains how to stitch links together so a huge number of towers can join without costly equipment.
